story: Stage 6 of the Tirreno–Adriatico was animated by an early breakaway that built a maximum advantage of around four minutes. UAE Team Emirates controlled the gap during the first part of the stage, keeping the move within reach. On the local circuit, Julian Alaphilippe did much of the work to reduce the advantage. On the first ascent to Camerino, Richard Carapaz attacked and bridged to a chasing group up the road, but the move was eventually brought back. The final breakaway riders were caught with 7 km remaining. On the final ascent towards Camerino Pellizari opened up a small gap on the group of favourites, but was eventually reeled back in by Del Toro and Jorgenson. In the final hundred meters Del Toro accelerated away from Jorgenson, taking the stage win.
